name: API & Backend Integration Test Automation
description: Automated API testing, contract validation, and backend service verification using Postman, REST Assured, and Pact. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: This skill is fundamentally different from Backend's be_testing_quality. In be_testing_quality, backend developers write unit tests and internal service integration tests for their own controllers/services. In qa_backend_api_automation, the QA engineer validates published API endpoints over HTTP, chains multi-service workflows, enforces schema contracts, and inspects database state solely as a test oracle after API operations (checking inserted/updated rows match expected test assertions — NOT database schema design or indexing optimization, which belongs to be_databases).

subskills.name: Postman & Newman Automation
subskills.description: Writing JavaScript assertions in Postman test scripts, environment variables, and CLI execution via Newman.

subskills.name: REST API Endpoint Validation
subskills.description: Testing RESTful endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH), validating JSON response schemas and HTTP status codes.

subskills.name: REST Assured Framework (Java/JVM)
subskills.description: Building Java/JVM-based API test automation suites using REST Assured (given-when-then syntax, Hamcrest matchers).

subskills.name: API State Management & Request Chaining
subskills.description: Extracting response tokens/IDs to dynamically parameterize subsequent downstream API requests.

subskills.name: JSON Schema & Contract Validation
subskills.description: Validating JSON Schema / XML DTD compliance against OpenAPI specifications to catch contract breaking changes.

subskills.name: GraphQL & gRPC API Testing
subskills.description: Testing GraphQL queries/mutations with variables and testing gRPC endpoints with Protobuf payloads.

subskills.name: Service Virtualization & WireMock
subskills.description: Setting up WireMock, Mockoon, or Prism mock servers for third-party dependency isolation in integration suites.

subskills.name: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing (Pact)
subskills.description: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing from a QA perspective using Pact and Pact Broker.

subskills.name: Database State Validation (Test Oracle)
subskills.description: Querying PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB from test code to verify that API operations resulted in the correct persisted database state (using DB strictly as a test oracle).
